title: ISH D DJ-video template manifest
description: Typed, versioned edit-plan manifest for the ISH D template engine (Phase 2). The manifest constrains, never expands: everything in it is a request the template engine is allowed to honor, and nothing more. Consumed identically by the visual proxy (Phase 3) and the future deterministic renderer (Phase 4).

manifest_version.description: Schema version. Bump only for an intentional breaking change to this file.

job_id.description: Short identifier for the job/mix. No spaces; use snake_case.

template.description: Versioned template name, resolved against the profile registry (editorial policy + preset density).

a_reel.description: Single A-camera file. One A-camera spine, continuous A audio.

b_reel.description: Ordered B-camera files. Treated as ONE virtual reel: durations concatenate in list order. Omit for A-Cam-Only jobs; any angle B cut requires it.

timeline.description: Ordered list of hard cuts. Within one angle, cuts must be sorted by source_in and must not overlap.

profiles.description: Versioned profile names resolved to LOCKED creative params in the profile registry. The app encodes these; it does not redesign them.

postflight.description: OPTIONAL — written by the postflight verifier onto the COMPLETED job manifest (never an input request). Records the QC results the refined plan requires: integrated loudness + BT.709 confirmation + delivery file.

true_peak_dbtp.description: True peak on the delivered file, must be <= -1.5 dBTP.

bt709.description: All three must be true for a passed BT.709 confirmation.

pre_grades_applied.description: OPTIONAL — Phase 6 QC record of exposure pre-grades the renderer applied (written by renderer postflight, never authored). Key = source name; value = {curve, ...}.

pre_grades.description: OPTIONAL — Phase 6 analyzer-written corrective exposure pre-grades. Keys MUST be exact source names declared in sources (a_reel or b_reel entries) — enforced by the validator. Values are ffmpeg filter fragments (curves=...). Applied BEFORE the locked creative grade; an absent source has no pre-grade.

id.description: Cut id, 1:1 with the proxy burn-in (cut_018 renders as CUT 018). Zero-padded, three digits. Must be unique within the timeline.

angle.description: A = a_reel (safe master). B = the b_reel virtual reel (concatenated files).

source_in.description: Source timecode in seconds. For B, measured on the concatenated virtual reel.

source_out.description: Source timecode in seconds; must be > source_in and within the source's real duration (checked against media when --media-root is given).

confidence.description: OPTIONAL (Phase 3). low = proxy burns a LOW CONF marker on this cut; high/absent = no marker. Drives the proxy's low-confidence burn-in only; no editorial effect yet.
